title: A wave archive's options: data/sound/wave_archives/<archive>/data.json
description: The options of a wave archive of the sound archive (swan_sound_data.sdat), named by a WAVE_* constant of data/constants/sound_wave_archives.txt. The archive's waves are the files beside this one, numbered from 000: a .swav file is a wave as the game has it, and a .wav file (mono, 8 or 16 bits) is encoded by tools/data/sound_waves.py. A WAV loops from the start of its first smpl chunk loop to its end, or doesn't loop if it has none. The file is optional.

single_load.description: Whether the game loads the archive's waves one by one, as each is needed

shares_data_with.description: Another wave archive whose waves this one has, in place of waves of its own

encoding.description: The encoding of the .wav files. Default adpcm

waves.description: Options of single .wav files, by number ("003")

loop.description: Whether the wave loops, which overrides its smpl chunk: from loop_start to the end

loop_start.description: The sample the loop starts at

encoding.description: adpcm is IMA ADPCM, a quarter of PCM16's size, as the game's own music uses; pcm8 and pcm16 are uncompressed
